proposed_message:
Hi Example Harbor Services team,

We reviewed your request for UK and Canada routing. Those regional rules are outside the signed scope under S4. We propose replacing the unstarted administrator training deliverable with the requested routing work. The routing price basis is USD 600.00 (4 hours × USD 150.00/hour), with a USD 600.00 credit for the training deliverable, making the proposed net change USD 0.00.

This is a proposal to revise the deliverables. It requires owner authorization and your explicit acceptance. No work will begin until both approvals are recorded.
summary: The requested UK and Canada routing is excluded by S4. This draft offers a budget-neutral substitution of the unstarted administrator training deliverable, subject to owner authorization and client acceptance.
title: UK and Canada routing in place of administrator training
